items.title: Threat Actors Exploiting SonicWall Firewalls to Deploy Akira Ransomware Using Malicious Logins
items.description: A new wave of cyberattacks targeting organizations using SonicWall firewalls has been actively deploying Akira ransomware since late July 2025. Security researchers at Arctic Wolf Labs detected a surge in this activity, which remains ongoing.
